title: Parent signs in and reaches the dashboard
description: This verifies that a parent can authenticate and access the main dashboard they use for afterschool bus management.

steps.description: Navigate to /parents/login
Fill in the parent login credentials with valid values
Submit the login form
Verify the parent dashboard is displayed
Verify child bus participation details are displayed

title: Teacher marks a student as boarded
description: A teacher can open the bus checklist, choose an assigned line, and mark a student as boarded with the progress updated.

steps.description: Navigate to /teacher/bus
Select an assigned bus line
Mark an individual student as boarded
Verify the student appears as boarded
Verify the boarding progress statistics update

title: Parent completes a bus checkout for a child
description: This verifies that a parent can review a child’s bus participation and complete the checkout action with the updated state shown afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /parents/login
Fill in the parent login credentials with valid values
Submit the login form
Review the child’s bus participation details
Complete the checkout action for the child
Verify the parent dashboard reflects the updated checkout state
Verify the child is no longer shown as awaiting checkout

title: Complete parent bus checkout for a child
description: A parent can review a child’s bus participation details, complete checkout, and see the dashboard reflect the updated state.

steps.description: Navigate to /parents/login

Submit the login form
Review a child’s bus participation details
Complete the bus checkout action for the child
Verify the child’s bus checkout state is updated on the parent dashboard

title: View parent dashboard after sign in

title: Teacher opens the bus checklist and marks students boarded

title: Admin completes afterschool master administration workflow
description: An admin can sign in, upload a bulk course file, edit student information and bus mappings, download the banking template, and export the final student list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the admin credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the afterschool administration panel
Upload a valid bulk course spreadsheet
Edit a student record and bus mapping
Download the school banking template
Export the full student list
Verify the imported and edited student data is displayed
Verify the template and export actions complete successfully
